test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct direct narration of the given sentence. **

The manager suggested to his team that they postpone the meeting until all of them had the information required.

options.text: The manager said to his team, “Let us postpone the meeting until all of you have the information required.”
The manager asked his team, “We will postpone the meeting until all of you have the required information.”
The team told the manager, “Let us postpone the meeting until all of us have the information required.”
The manager told his team, “Postpone the meeting until all of you have the information required.”

solution:
The correct answer is: **The manager said to his team, “Let us postpone the meeting until all of you have the information required.” **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is an indirect speech and we need to convert it into a **direct **speech.
 
• The given sentence is also an imperative sentence.
 
• We follow these rules in Direct-Indirect speech for an imperative sentence:
 
 
• The sense of command, order, advise, request and suggest is implied in the reported clause of the sentence. We have to change the reporting verb in accordance with the mood of the sentence. 
 
• In the imperative sentence the reporting verb **‘said’, ‘said to’, ‘told’ **changes to **advised, command, requested, ordered, etc**. depending on the mood of the sentence. 
 
• Imperative sentence changes to statement form [direct to indirect speech]
 
• The conjunction ‘that’ is used to connect reporting and reported clause.
 
• In the indirect speech if we use** 'advised', 'suggested' **etc then it denotes a proposal and we must use **'Let'** in the direct speech part.
 
 
 
• Example -* **Dad said to my brother, “Work hard to succeed.” (Direct)*

* Dad advised my brother to work hard to succeed. (Indirect)*

Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

The Direct sentence is: *The manager said to his team, “Let us postpone the meeting until all of you have the information required.” *
